  On June 16 and 17, during The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Board of Governors Meeting and Annual
  Convocation, The Hebrew University will confer Honorary Doctorates upon AFHU Chairman of the Board an
  Honorary President George A. Schieren, and legendary American actress, director, singer, producer, compose'
  philanthropist and activist Barbra Streisand. Honorary Fellowships will be conferred upon distinguished AFHU
  leaders, Renee Jacobs-Anson and David Bruce Smith.

  We are pleased to invite you to view the Honorary Doctorate and Fellowship ceremonies being held during
  the 2013 Hebrew University Jerusalem Board of Governors Meeting and Annual Convocation as the events
  stream live. Click here to view the live stream. Below find the scheduled ceremony times and dates.

  Sunday June 16, 2013
  2:30 - 4:30 pm (begins 7:30 am EST)
  George A. Schieren, Honorary Doctorate

  Monday, June 17, 2013
  3:15 - 4:45 pm (begins 8:15 am EST)
  Barbra Streisand, Honorary Doctorate
  Renee Jacobs-Anson, Honorary Fellow
  David Bruce Smith, Honorary Fellow
